title: Package Cancellations and Deposit Refunds — Good Faith & Price Estimates Terms
content:
**Who may cancel.** Only the patient can cancel a requested Good Faith & Price Estimates estimate or a scheduled package service.

**Full refund.** A cancellation made at least the type's full-refund days before the scheduled service date (counting back from the service date, the cancellation date being on or before that day) refunds every deposit in full.

**Later cancellation — retired wording.** The clause "a later cancellation retains the late-cancellation fee from the deposits, never more than the deposits held, unless the cancelling physician documents a medical reason; the remainder is refunded" is **no longer in force** in that form. In its place: a cancellation that ends a package booking keeps the type's late-cancellation fee from the deposits when made later than the full-refund days, never more than the deposits held, unless the cancelling physician documents a medical reason, the remainder being refunded; and a move made at least the full-refund days before the slot date, or one Riverbend initiated, carries no fee. The fee kept on a late patient move of a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking is not settled by this clause.

**How the fee and refunds are drawn.** The fee is retained once, from the most recent deposit collection that can cover it. Each deposit collection is refunded at most once — whether a refund already draws on a collection is read from the estimate's deposit activity — by the original payment method within the type's refund period in calendar days of the cancellation. A Riverbend-initiated reschedule or cancellation never incurs the fee.

**Amounts.** The fee retained on a cancellation that ends a package booking is the lesser of the type's late-cancellation fee and the deposits held; the refund is the deposits held less the fee retained.

## Boundary cases (abstract dates; type with 7 full-refund days, service on day S)

| Cancellation date | Result |
|---|---|
| 7 days before S, or earlier | every deposit refunded in full |
| 6 days before S | late cancellation: fee kept, remainder refunded |
| any date, cancelling physician documents a medical reason | fee waived |
| any date, Riverbend initiated | no fee |

## Example (hypothetical figures)

Deposits held 100.00 on a type whose late-cancellation fee is larger than that: fee retained 100.00, refund 0.00. Deposits held 900.00 and a fee of 150.00: fee retained 150.00, refund 750.00.

superseded_clauses: A later cancellation retains late_cancellation_fee_usd from the deposits, never more than the deposits held, unless the cancelling physician documents a medical reason (medical_cancellation_fee_waived); the remainder is refunded.
